The Group (Kenya Bank, South Sudan Branch,
SBG Securities and Stanbic Insurance Agency
Limited) reported a profit after tax of KES 12.2b;
▪ Improvement in Net Interest Income on
the back of growth in the lending book
and improved margins
▪ Growth in non-interest income mainly
driven by growth in trading revenue on
increased volumes and better margins
as well as Investment banking and
mobile banking fees
▪ Costs growth reflecting the high
inflationary pressure coupled with
business growth costs and currency
depreciation. Adjusted for these, YoY
growth on costs is 12%
▪ Increase in credit impairment charges
mirroring tough operating environment
